Acme Robotics builds fleet software for warehouse robots. We are hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to own product features end to end, from PostgreSQL schemas and Node.js APIs to React and Next.js front ends.

What you will do
- Build and run TypeScript services on Node.js and PostgreSQL.
- Ship React and Next.js interfaces our operators use every day.
- Design event-driven workflows with queues, retries and webhooks.
- Review code and help other engineers ship safely.

Requirements
- 6+ years building production web applications in TypeScript.
- Strong React, Next.js and Node.js experience.
- PostgreSQL schema design and query tuning.
- Experience with Cloudflare Workers or similar serverless platforms.
- Go is a plus.

Location: fully remote, worldwide. We work in English.

How to apply: send your CV and a short cover letter, and tell us your notice period.
